主要内容: Consumer spending is gaining despite wavering confidence. Sentiment improved in early August 2016, ending three consecutive months of declines. Economic and political uncertainty weighed on consumer confidence, but growing personal wealth and low interest rates are expected to support continued consumption growth and retail sales. The August 2016 edition of the Consumer Products & Retail Insider, released by Brown Gibbons Lang & Company (BGL), examines trends in the Pet and Facility Management industries. The Pet Industry, valued at $77 billion, is expected to reach $100 billion by 2020 due to the humanization/premiumization movement. Mergers include PETCO (CVC Capital Partners and CPPIB) and Pet Supermarket/Pet Valu (Roark Capital). In Facility Management, a $780 billion global market is projected to reach $945 billion by 2025. Fragmentation will drive consolidation as firms seek technology and service capabilities. Recent investments include SMS Assist (Goldman Sachs Investment Partners) and Vixxo (Wind River Holdings). BGL is a leading independent investment bank specializing in M&A advisory, debt/equity placements, and valuations, with offices in Chicago, Cleveland, and Philadelphia.
